company_identity.context: medical hair removal / consultation-led clinical service

first_party_sources.role: free counseling, risks, physician/staff flow, test irradiation, application
medical-hair-removal positioning, doctor support, plan context
treatment suitability and medical boundary examples

verified_company_truth: A free counseling session is required before contract; the official page currently describes it as approximately 90 minutes.
Counseling explains the hair-removal mechanism, treatment method, costs, self-care/aftercare and customer concerns before commitment.
A physician checks skin/hair/body condition and determines whether treatment is appropriate; treatment can be refused or limited depending on condition, medication or other factors.
Counseling staff explain plan-specific risks, prices, follow-up and refund information; the official page states there is no forced solicitation.
A test irradiation route is available for customers who request it when booking counseling.
The current official site provides multiple plan structures and a Web route to book free counseling.

customer_decision_state.before: The customer understands medical hair removal as a category but has high anxiety about suitability, safety, risk, cost and what happens before treatment.
customer_decision_state.first_persuasive_job: reduce wrong-choice and safety anxiety with bounded, inspectable reassurance before asking for commitment
customer_decision_state.after: The customer understands what will be checked, what will be explained, where uncertainty remains, and can choose whether to book free counseling.
customer_decision_state.decision_job_signal: safety/suitability reassurance leads; mechanism/process proof supports

creative_fit.score_semantics: Issue #49 expert ordinal strength; not probability or learned runtime weight

family_inference_trace.dominance_rule: When suitability/safety/wrong-choice anxiety is the gating question, BW-F02 leads. BW-F06 may support with mechanism/process proof but must not replace the reassurance job.
family_inference_trace.human_review_trigger: If generated truth reframes the page primarily around efficacy/mechanism and suppresses suitability/risk boundaries, review F02 vs F06 before rendering.

notes: Official source richness does not contribute to Family selection.
Visible official-site imagery does not imply reusable production rights; rights must be verified or realization must adapt without changing BW-F02.
Current prices and operational details are volatile facts and must be re-verified at implementation time.

required_emphasis: Evidence/suitability signal must appear before aspirational or sensory persuasion.
Known/unknown and eligibility boundaries must stay adjacent to medical claims.
Counseling/physician/process truth should be distributed as reassurance rather than collapsed into a generic feature wall.
Commitment should ladder toward free counseling, not simulate a direct treatment purchase.

vs_nagi: Do not use Nagi's category-recognition opening as the dominant first-view logic.
Do not reproduce Nagi's intent-routed three-service field or abstract quiet-wellness copy rhythm.
Increase factual density and boundary visibility; reduce atmosphere-first whitespace as the dominant persuasion mechanism.
CTA is 'book free counseling' after reassurance, not 'choose a service mode / consult by Instagram'.
vs_company_03_uka: Regina must lead with clinical reassurance/boundaries; uka must lead with human technique/provenance.
Regina media cannot carry proof merely through mood; uka may use atmosphere only when it supports method/human authorship.
Regina composition should feel inspectable and bounded, not craft-editorial.

media_roles_needed: consultation/physician context where rights and identity are safe
equipment or treatment-context media only when it does not imply unverified efficacy
clinic/facility context for orientation, not as a substitute for medical proof
clear factual typography/diagram roles for risks, steps and boundaries
evidence_safety_constraints: Do not invent efficacy, pain, duration, eligibility or medical-outcome claims.
Do not present generated people as actual physicians/staff/patients or as testimonial evidence.
Do not use before/after imagery as proof unless provenance, consent, rights and claim context are verified.
Keep free-counseling duration, plan prices, campaign terms and clinic availability date-stamped and re-verifiable.
Preserve contraindication/suitability uncertainty instead of converting it into reassuring certainty.

expected_cta_logic.primary: 無料カウンセリングを予約する
expected_cta_logic.secondary: 料金・施術の流れ・FAQを確認する
expected_cta_logic.choreography: reassurance/boundary → process clarity → plan context → state-specific counseling CTA

human_visible_risks: A generic beauty-clinic gradient/card design could erase the medical reassurance logic.
Too much dense text can become an institutional FAQ wall rather than authored persuasion.
Clinical imagery can falsely imply proof or real staff identity if provenance is weak.
Responsive collapse must not detach risk/boundary copy from the claim it qualifies.
template_swap_failure_conditions: Nagi hero/section order is retained and only colors/copy/images are swapped.
The page uses the same pale wellness/editorial gestalt, rounded-photo rhythm and abstract calm copy as Nagi despite the different trust job.
Evidence-first and boundary patterns are absent while generic service cards dominate.
Family metadata says BW-F02 but screenshot gestalt remains BW-F08-style open discovery.
Production Feasibility changes the expected Family.

rin_validation_contract.counterfactual: Run at least one lower-asset/rights-constrained feasibility profile and assert dominant Family remains BW-F02.
